question: Which accounting jobs can software do, and which still need a person?
answer: Of the 16 accounting jobs in the library's map, software working from reliable event records can do 6 strongly: identity; authority; settlement; internal control; reconciliation; correction and recovery. Three more are strong once a condition holds: classification, when facts are complete; allocation, for fixed rules; reporting and disclosure, after judgments. Six can be done only partly: entity and perimeter; occurrence / existence; rights and obligations; recognition; close and consolidation; assurance. Measurement is mixed. The map's rule of thumb: the closer a function is to identity, authorization, arithmetic, sequencing and reconciliation, the more programmable it is. The closer it is to economic substance, legal rights, uncertain measurement and materiality, the more judgment remains.

sections.title: Job by job, in the map's four groups
sections.sub: From the July 30, 2026 functions map (evidence cutoff July 30, 2026), grouped as in the thesis map of September 28, 2026.

groups.label: Economic and legal perimeter
groups.note: Technology is strong at identity and rule-bound authority. It remains dependent on law, beneficial ownership, physical evidence, side agreements, title, control, agency relationships and related-party facts.

items.title: Entity and perimeter
kv: The question it answers
Whose assets, liabilities and activity are reported?
Can software do it from reliable events?
partly
What still needs a person or off-chain evidence
control, beneficial ownership, VIEs, agents, related parties
In the September map
whose activity is reported

items.title: Identity
kv: The question it answers
Which legal person or account acted?
Can software do it from reliable events?
strongly
What still needs a person or off-chain evidence
stolen credentials, nominees, beneficial owner
In the September map
which legal person, account, role or credential acted

items.title: Authority
kv: The question it answers
Was the transaction permitted?
Can software do it from reliable events?
strongly
What still needs a person or off-chain evidence
validity of law/contract, delegation, collusion
In the September map
whether the act was permitted

items.title: Occurrence / existence
kv: The question it answers
Did the event or asset exist?
Can software do it from reliable events?
partly
What still needs a person or off-chain evidence
physical delivery, service performance, inventory existence
In the September map
whether the event or asset exists

items.title: Rights and obligations
kv: The question it answers
Who owns the asset or owes the duty?
Can software do it from reliable events?
partly
What still needs a person or off-chain evidence
title, side agreements, liens, legal interpretation
In the September map
who owns, controls or owes what

groups.label: Accounting transformation
groups.note: Classification and fixed arithmetic can often be encoded. Recognition, measurement and settlement remain different clocks. A final payment does not prove performance; a token balance does not decide legal control; a market price does not by itself select the GAAP measurement basis.

items.title: Classification

badge.text: Software: strongly when facts are complete

kv: The question it answers
What kind of economic event is it?
Can software do it from reliable events?
strongly when facts are complete
What still needs a person or off-chain evidence
novel instruments, substance over form
In the September map
what kind of event or economic object it is

items.title: Recognition
kv: The question it answers
When does it enter the accounts?
Can software do it from reliable events?
partly
What still needs a person or off-chain evidence
performance obligations, contingencies, control transfer
In the September map
whether and when it enters the accounts

items.title: Measurement
kv: The question it answers
At what amount?
Can software do it from reliable events?
mixed
What still needs a person or off-chain evidence
fair value, impairment, useful life, probability, model inputs
In the September map
at what amount and with which valuation inputs

items.title: Allocation
kv: The question it answers
Which period, product, award or program bears the cost?
Can software do it from reliable events?
strongly for fixed rules
What still needs a person or off-chain evidence
causal allocation and policy choices
In the September map
which period, product, award, entity or program bears it

items.title: Settlement
kv: The question it answers
When and how did money or an asset move?
Can software do it from reliable events?
strongly
What still needs a person or off-chain evidence
off-chain bank finality, reversals, custody perimeter
In the September map
when and how the money or asset leg becomes final at its relevant tier

groups.label: Integrity and reporting production
groups.note: These are the layers where persistent IDs, versioned mappings and continuous exception routing can remove large amounts of reconstruction work. They still depend on complete populations, governed mappings and current judgment.

items.title: Internal control
kv: The question it answers
Who approved, segregated and reviewed it?
Can software do it from reliable events?
strongly
What still needs a person or off-chain evidence
override, coercion, shared keys, corrupt approvals
In the September map
approval, segregation, access, change and review

items.title: Reconciliation
kv: The question it answers
Do subledgers, banks and counterparties agree?
Can software do it from reliable events?
strongly
What still needs a person or off-chain evidence
missing or unreliable source systems
In the September map
agreement across counterparties, banks, chains, subledgers and general ledgers

items.title: Close and consolidation
kv: The question it answers
What adjustments and eliminations produce the reporting entity?
Can software do it from reliable events?
partly
What still needs a person or off-chain evidence
estimates, intercompany perimeter, late information
In the September map
estimates, eliminations, entity perimeter, translation, top-side adjustments and period lock

items.title: Reporting and disclosure
kv: The question it answers
What must users be told?
Can software do it from reliable events?
strongly after judgments
What still needs a person or off-chain evidence
materiality, aggregation, narrative context
In the September map
the presentation and narrative supplied to a defined user

groups.label: Trust and remedy
groups.note: Immutability increases the importance of explicit remedy. A correctable system preserves the original, the reason, the authorized correcting event, affected periods, later report versions and the route back to a trusted operating state.

items.title: Assurance
kv: The question it answers
Is evidence sufficient and appropriate?
Can software do it from reliable events?
partly
What still needs a person or off-chain evidence
source reliability, physical facts, estimates, professional judgment
In the September map
whether evidence is sufficient and appropriate for a defined assertion and conclusion

items.title: Correction and recovery
kv: The question it answers
How is an error, reversal, restatement or collection preserved?
Can software do it from reliable events?
strongly
What still needs a person or off-chain evidence
legal cause, responsibility, collectibility
In the September map
reversal, supersession, restatement, refund, debt, collection, migration and reopening

sections.title: The same split, cycle by cycle
sections.sub: From the Full Thesis Map (evidence cutoff September 28, 2026).
columns: Where judgment or off-chain evidence stays
rows: Order to cash
contract IDs, delivery events, billing, receivables, cash application, refunds
enforceable terms, performance obligations, side agreements, variable consideration, collectibility
Procure to pay
vendor authority, purchase order, receipt, invoice match, payable, payment
real receipt/service, capitalization, embedded leases, contingencies, collusion
Payroll and compensation
identity, time, rate, withholding, vesting and payment schedules
worker classification, bonus estimates, award valuation, actuarial assumptions
Inventory and cost of sales
provenance, custody, quantity, cost layers, recall and cutoff
physical existence/condition, title, overhead, obsolescence, net realizable value
Long-lived assets and leases
cost capture, location, placed-in-service event, schedules, disposal
unit of account, capitalization, useful life, impairment, lease term and discount rate
Treasury, debt, equity and crypto
balances, confirmations, interest, collateral, settlement, cap-table states
cash classification, legal control, debt/equity, derivatives, hedge designation, fair value
Tax
jurisdiction tags, book-tax mappings, rate application, remittance
nexus, law, uncertain positions, valuation allowances, cross-border structure
Consolidation and close
matching, routine elimination, translation, provenance and period controls
reporting entity, VIE/control, estimates, going concern, subsequent events, materiality

uncertain: This is the library's own analytical map, not a ruling by FASB, the PCAOB or the SEC.
Standards checked through September 28, 2026: None supplies a general real-time GAAP or continuous-public-assurance regime.
Continuous monitoring is management activity, not independent assurance.
A smart contract does not know GAAP.
The per-job 'programmable zone' wording on the Accounting Transition page lives only inside that page; this page uses the functions map's table instead.

catalog_context.title: Accounting built from shared business events
catalog_context.answer: Accounting is moving from piecing together scattered records after the fact to building the books from shared business events. Licenses, accounting labels, audit reports and corrections are also being used to decide who may act, invest or rely on the result.

catalog_context.title: How real-time shared records could change auditing
catalog_context.answer: Blockchain, smart contracts and AI can make books update nearly in real time, but none of them is an audit, and today's SEC reporting and audit opinions are still tied to fixed periods.
